Bounceables - Title Update 1.4 Notes

[April 3, 2022] – New features / General Improvements

- New Bounceables radio

- A new main menu has been implemented
- A new shop tab has been added
- A new pass tab has been added
- A pause menu has been implemented

- Fixed an issue causing the wrong music to play
- Fixed an issue with the credits

[December 11th, 2021] – General Improvements

- Fixed an issue causing the score to continue counting on certain maps
